claim: Eight fixed 60-second laps, each of the first seven with three modifiers, end at a guarded final core with a result and build code.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /?test=1; start the sample, choose modifiers by key and button, and assert the eighth-lap result; the same test advances the fixed core through exactly 8 × 60 seconds

claim: The ?demo=1 sample starts in one click, is separate from real progress and settings, and is discarded when starting for real.
sandbox: fresh browser context from /; preload real settings, enter /?demo=1 in one click, change demo settings, reset, start for real, and assert only demo-prefixed session keys changed or were removed

claim: Assist mode starts the next run with a wider paddle, slower orb, and one more hull point.
sandbox: fresh demo context; save Assist mode, assert isolated persistence, and measure the shared gameplay values for paddle width, launch speed, and hull

claim: Every modifier card has the precise effect stated on it.
sandbox: fresh demo context; assert each card's exact copy and exercise the shared game calculations for width, speed, score, split, hull, magnet, drill, bonus, and steady effects

claim: Game settings add J/L or H/K movement keys and Escape pause while arrow keys and A/D remain available.
sandbox: fresh real-run context; save each mapping, use J/L, H/K, ArrowLeft, and Escape on the playfield, and assert the selected controls receive the three-pixel focus ring

claim: The same sample choices produce the same build code.
sandbox: fresh demo context at /demo?test=1; finish the same seeded run twice with the same choices and compare build codes

claim: A completed run's build code can be copied.
sandbox: fresh demo context at /demo?test=1; finish the run, activate Copy build code, read the browser clipboard, compare it with the displayed code, and verify the denied-permission fallback

claim: Each missed orb costs one hull point, and zero hull ends the run.
sandbox: fresh demo context plus deterministic core state; force four missed orbs and assert each hull decrement and the loss state

claim: Keyboard and touch controls both move the paddle.
sandbox: fresh 390px browser context at /play; move right by keyboard and left by the on-screen touch control

claim: Dragging across the playfield moves the paddle.
sandbox: fresh 390px browser context at /play; drag from one quarter to three quarters across the canvas and assert the paddle follows

claim: P pauses and resumes a run with the default controls.
sandbox: fresh real-run context with default settings; press P, assert the saved-lap overlay and frozen simulation tick, press P again, and assert play resumes

claim: Reloading restores the same run progress and settings in this browser.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /play; advance and pause a run, save a setting, reload, and compare the restored lap, clock, score, hull, simulation tick, and setting

claim: An active run automatically saves progress once per second.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /play; record real local-storage writes without pausing or changing settings, and assert two playing-state checkpoints arrive one second apart

claim: A completed real run saves its best result in this browser.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /play?test=1; finish the real eight-lap run, assert the stored score and build, reload, and assert the record is unchanged

claim: The game keeps a 14–18 ms median frame interval and a 90th-percentile interval no slower than 34 ms on a 390px mid-range phone simulation.
sandbox: fresh 390px touch/mobile browser context at /demo with 4× CPU throttling; wait for page resources and an idle turn, use a held pointer to follow the visible orb, discard 180 warm-up frames, record 900 playing-state requestAnimationFrame intervals, and assert a 14–18 ms nearest-rank median plus p90 at or below 34 ms

claim: The game has no account, purchases, ads, analytics, or personal-data requests.
where: landing facts, privacy page, terms, README
sandbox: record every request during a fresh demo flow, assert same-origin game files only, and assert there are no account, checkout, payment, external-form, or iframe controls

claim: The game reloads offline after the first visit.
sandbox: new browser context at /demo; wait for the service worker, reload online once, set the context offline, then reload and assert the game heading
fresh browser context with prefers-reduced-motion enabled; cause a real brick hit, assert star positions remain fixed, no shake is recorded, and UI transitions reduce to 0.01 ms
